title: Oven Roasted Kenyan Wagyu Skewers
description: A smoky and light Kenyan dish featuring Wagyu beef, perfect for a quick-fix dinner, and friendly to Shojin dietary preferences.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Wagyu beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
